visualLanguage: design_system/public/PUBLIC_UI.md. The KB-era index.html that used to sit in this directory was DELETED 2026-08-27: it was retired as a visual target on 2026-08-26 and kept only because ci:mockup-coverage required a parity.json beside any index.html, which is a gate keeping a dead file alive. The target is the patterns in PUBLIC_UI.md, built from components/site/v3. THIS FILE STILL BINDS: requiredComponents is what stops a page silently losing a section, and ci:mockup-parity reads it with or without a mockup.
competitiveTarget: Beat generic national-brokerage profile pages by putting all three live broker faces on the first 390 screen with 44px Call/Text, telling the origin once (fire service, Red Erickson, no hand-off, video + 3D), and keeping OREA licenses as a quiet line. About is who we are. Inventory lives on /housing-market.
note: Look 2026-08-29: About = faces first, then origin. Order is Breadcrumb, AboutFaces trio (H1 About Ryan Realty, all three /images/brokers/*.png cutouts on 390, names, 44px Call/Text, cookie tap reserved), Quiet #about (How it started), Quiet #record (Verified record as a license line, no Amboqia numerals), Quiet #faq (same-broker, towns, valuation — no boutique sentence, no origin retell, no license retell), Footer. One sentence of towns plus a /housing-market door. City inventory ledger is gone. PUBLIC_UI.md opens About on Quiet + Sheet. Faces are Stage's job without V3Stage's full-bleed frame. The family's Sheet lives on /contact and /team/[slug]. Seller lives on Sell.

requiredComponents.name: MetadataBlock
requiredComponents.section: AboutPage + aboutOrganization + BreadcrumbList + FAQPage JSON-LD. V3Quiet carries no structured data of its own.

requiredComponents.name: V3Breadcrumb
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. Home > About. Surface tone (this page opens on cream faces, not a dark Stage). Current page never a link.

requiredComponents.name: AboutFaces
requiredComponents.section: First viewport. Live brokers from getBrokers, canonical /images/brokers/*.png cutouts. Trio on 390: H1 plus all three faces (smaller crops), names, 44px Call/Text. Cookie chip space reserved. Name is the door to /team/[slug]. No card, no wash, no rectangular box. Compact H1 lives here.

requiredComponents.name: V3Quiet
requiredComponents.section: Pattern 6, three times. How it started (fire service, Red Erickson, no hand-off, video + 3D, one sentence of towns, housing-market door). Verified record as a quiet license line. FAQ: same-broker, towns, valuation. No boutique community sentence.

requiredComponents.name: V3Footer
requiredComponents.section: Chrome. V3_FOOTER_COLUMNS. Rendered OUTSIDE <main> so the footer maps to role=contentinfo. Column titles are not H2. Links stay --v3-tap.

layoutComponents.name: PublicNav
layoutComponents.note: Resolves to V3Chrome today. The KbNav entry above is the one the gate auto-satisfies.

deferredComponents.name: V3Sheet
deferredComponents.reason: About destinations open on Quiet + Sheet, but the capture forms already live on /contact and /team/[slug]. Adding a Sheet here would be a new capture contract.

deferredComponents.name: V3Stage
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 4 needs owned media and is never allowed over a number. V3Stage is one full-bleed frame with a navy scrim, which would put a rectangle behind the transparent broker PNGs. AboutFaces does that owned-media job on cream instead.

deferredComponents.name: V3Field
deferredComponents.reason: Pattern 2 is live inventory as a spatial surface. It opens Homes. Using it here would compete with /homes-for-sale.

deferredComponents.name: V3Instrument
deferredComponents.reason: Verified record is a quiet license line. Giant Amboqia numerals compete with market and do not belong on About.

deferredComponents.name: V3Ledger
deferredComponents.reason: City inventory ledger is off About. One sentence of towns plus a door to /housing-market.
